title: E-commerce Marketing for Online Stores in Pakistan: Where to Start
desc: A practical starting guide to marketing an online store in Pakistan: product pages, trust, ads, tracking, retargeting and repeat customers.
answer: E-commerce marketing means getting the right people to your online store and making it easy for them to buy. Start with clear product pages and trust signals such as delivery and return details, then bring visitors through Google Ads, Meta Ads and email or WhatsApp follow-up. Track orders properly so you know which channel pays for itself, and work on repeat customers, not only new ones.
body: Fix the store before spending on traffic

Ads send visitors, but your store decides whether they buy. Before you spend, check that each product page has clear photos, a plain description, the price, delivery time and charges, and how to order. Visitors should never have to guess.
Show delivery areas, time and charges.
List payment options, including cash on delivery if you offer it.
Show a working phone or WhatsApp number and real business details.
2. Make buying easy on a phone
Many shoppers order from their phone. Test your own checkout: how many steps, how many fields, does it load quickly? Remove anything that is not needed to place the order.
Google Search and Shopping ads reach people already looking for a product.
Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) introduce products to people who did not know to search.
SEO builds free traffic over time through good category and product pages.
Email and WhatsApp messages bring past customers back.
Start with one or two channels and learn what works before adding more.
Set up conversion tracking so each order is linked to the ad or channel that brought it. Without it you cannot tell which spending pays for itself. Our conversion tracking guide explains the basics.
Your profit per order after product cost, delivery and returns.
What you can afford to pay to win one order.
Your return rate, which affects real profit.
Revenue alone is misleading. A campaign that brings many orders can still lose money if costs are higher than margins.
Most visitors do not buy the first time. Retargeting ads, abandoned cart reminders and follow-up messages can remind them. Satisfied customers who buy again cost less to win than new ones.
Sending ad traffic to the home page instead of the product.
No tracking, so decisions are guesses.
Judging ads on clicks instead of orders and profit.
If you want help, our e-commerce marketing service starts with your store, products and margins, then agrees a plan that fits your budget.
faq: How much should I spend on ads for my online store?
It depends on your margins and goals. Start with an amount you can afford to test, review orders and profit, and adjust. We do not promise returns.
Is Google Ads or Meta Ads better for e-commerce?
They do different jobs. Google reaches people searching for products, Meta introduces products to new people. Many stores use both over time.
Do I need a website or can I sell on social media only?
You can start on social media, but your own store gives more control, clear information and tracking. Many businesses use both.
Why do I get visitors but no orders?
Common causes are unclear product pages, missing delivery or returns details, a complicated checkout or poor tracking. Review these before increasing ad spend.
